verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe three of the story's core capabilities: AI-suggested summaries during incidents (docs-11/41/53/70), AI 'Suggestions' that auto-draft updates and follow-up actions (docs-12/54), and Scribe, which transcribes/scribes incident calls (docs-13/30/55). Together these map directly onto 'live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating Scribe's note quality or summary accuracy in real incidents, and richer documentation of the live/real-time nature of summary generation beyond brief doc snippets.
